tei:div.tei:p: (1) ༄༅// 'dul ba'i lag len rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (2) oṃ swasti/ phul byung thugs bskyed rtsa ba rab brtan tshogs gnyis mdzes pa'i yal gas spras// bsam yas yon tan 'dab mas phyug cing sku gsum 'bras bu'i khur gyis lci// sna tshogs nyon mongs tsha gdung skyob mdzad gcig tu dge ba'i bsil grib can// bcom ldan thub dbang lha yi lha la sgo gsum gus pas bstod par bgyi// brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs rims nad tshogs// gang zhig bsten na yud kyis mthar byas te// 'pho med bde ba'i dbugs dbyung sbyin mdzad pa// chos 'dul bdud rtsi'i gter la bdag phyag 'tshal// mkhyen pas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i chos mdzod 'dzin// brtse bas ris bral 'gro la bu bzhin dgongs// (3) nus pas dpag dka'i 'khor ba'i mtha' bsnyil ba// 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// gdul dka'i 'gro la thugs brtse'i gzhan dbang gis// rdul bral zhi ba'i lam bzang legs 'doms pa// sdom gsum bka' drin stsol ba'i drin chen rje// 'dren mchog bla ma'i tshogs la phyag bgyi'o// tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po las 'ong gzhan phan thugs bskyed shing rtas drangs// mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs rdzogs brtse chen ri bong gzugs kyis mtshan// rnam gsum sde snod lha yi lam zhugs lung dang rigs pa'i 'od phreng can// blo gsal gdul bya'i kun+da'i gnyen gyur dge ba'i bshes la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal// thub pa mchog (4) gi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// spang blang 'byed par 'dod pa'i grogs dag la// phan par bsams nas bla ma'i gsung bzhin du// legs par brjod pa 'di la gsan par zhu// de la 'dir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum la slob dgos shing*/ de'i nang nas kyang thog mar lhag pa tshul khris kyi bslab pa la slob dgos par gsungs pas/

de la 'jug par 'dod pa dag gis lag tu len pa'i rim pa mdo tsam brjod na/ dang po sdom pa blang ba'i thabs/ bar du srung ba'i thabs/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po la/ sdom pa'i ngo bo/ cho ga'i rab dbye/ thob pa'i mtshams/ gtong ba'i rgyu sogs rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya la/ lag tu len pa'i rim pa ni sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga rnams su gsal bas ma spros so// 'dir sdom pa skye mi skye la dogs pa cung zad dpyad na/ kha cig gi bsam pa la/ 'greng yul 'dun sogs phul ba min// ma rdzogs nyams dang mtshams med min// sdig pa tha dad 'khrul bcas min// mtshams mtshan dkon mchog gzhan min pa'o// zhes pa'i kha (5) skong gi chos bcu gsum po gang rung dang mi ldan na de dag gis las kyi cho ga byas kyang las mi 'chag par gsungs la/ bsdam bya'i nyes pa tsam gyis kyang kha skong gi chos dang mi ldan par 'gyur bas/ da lta'i dge slong rnams la bsdam byar ma zad bshags bya'i nyes pas kyang ma gos pa mi rnyed pas de dag gis las byas kyang las mi 'chag pa'i phyir dang*/ bsgrub byas cho ga yongs rdzogs kyi don mi shes pas sdom pa mi skye/ des na da lta'i dge tshul slong rnams ni ming tsam mo snyam na/ ma yin te/ las gral du 'dus pa'i dus su dge slong rnams kyis ltung ba bsdam 'os rnams bsdams bshags 'os rnams bshags/ byin gyis brlab 'os rnams gsol ba'i las kyis byin gyis rlobs par byed la/ de dag byas pas lhag ma man chad kyi ltung bas las la sgrib pa 'dag par 'gyur te/ mdo rtsar byin gyis brlabs pas dag pa nyid du 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas so// gzhan yang khyim pas mkhan po byas kyang bsgrub byas khyim par ma shes na sdom pa skye bar gsungs/ yul gyi ngos nas de ltar yin yang*/ bsgrub bya'i ngos nas mi skye'o snyam na/ ma nges te/ zhu bar/ btsun pa mtha' 'khob pa 'phags pa'i skad du bsnyen par

(6) rdzogs pa bgyis pa dang*/ mtha' 'khob pas 'phags pa'i skad du ma 'tshal na bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bgyi'am/ de ste gsung rab 'di dang ldan zhing khas len pa'i sems yod na bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes bya ste zhes pa la sogs par gsungs shing*/ mdo rtsar glen pa la skye la nyes byas su gsungs pas so// des na sngon gyi mkhan slob lta bu rnyed dka' yang*/ bslab bya bsrung sdom la brtson pa'i mkhan slob sogs rang rang gi bya ba'i las la mi rmongs pa dag gis/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga lag len ltar byas shing*/ bsgrub byas kyang yul 'di dag las sdom pa blangs te bsrung snyam pa yod na sdom pa skye mi skye the tshom mi za/ cho ga 'khrug pa len sems log pa sogs kyis sdom pa mi skye ba'ang yod mod mtha' gcig tu zhen par mi bya'o// gal te sdom pa tsam skye ba yod kyang so thar gyi sdom pa ni med de/ deng sang gi rab byung phal cher la nges 'byung gi bsam pa med pa'i phyir zhe na/ mi 'thad de myang 'das kyi bsam pa brtan po rgyun chags su med na'ang*/ sdom pa len pa'i tshe mkhan slob kyis myang 'das kyi bsam pa dgos so zhes brda sprad pas nges 'byung gi bsam pa skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ legs par brda sprad pas sdom pa thob pa'i dus shes pa bzhin no// nges 'byung gi bsam pa (7) brtan po med na de tsam gyis go mi chod snyam na/ de ltar na kun dga' bo'i tsha bo gnyis dang*/ gcung dga' bo chos can/ nges 'byung gi sdom pa rgyud ldan gyi gang zag ma yin par thal/ nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan po med par gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ha cang thal lo// yi ges 'jigs pas zhib par gzhan du btsal lo// gnyis pa bar du bsrung ba'i thabs bstan pa la drug gang zag gzhan la bsten nas bsrung ba dang*/ rang gi bsam pa phun tshogs kyis dang*/ rkyen dgos dang ldan pa'i tshe thabs khyad par can gyis dang*/

spang bya ngo shes nas dang*/ bslab pa yongs sbyong gi sgo nas dang*/ bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba'o// dang po la'ang gsum ste/ gnas 'cha' ba'i tshul/ gnas la bsten pa'i tshul/ de ltar bsten pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu'i bar du gnas la bsten dgos shing*/ de yang mkhan po yod na gnas su gyur zin pas gnas 'cha' ba'i cho ga mi dgos par bsten pas chog med na bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu lon pa lnga phrugs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig gam/ dus dbang gis de lta bu ma rnyed na spang blang gi gnas 'doms par byed pa'i dge slong bzang po zhig la (8) gnas 'cha' ste/ de yang yul gyi sgyid pa la bzung nas mgo bos rkang pa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas te ngag tu/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba btsun pa la gnas 'cha' bar gsol na/ btsun pas bdag la gnas stsol cig bdag btsun pa la gnas 'cha' zhing mchis so zhes lan gsum brjod/ dge tshul gyis kyang de bzhin bya// 'on kyang slob dpon gcig gis dge tshul gcig las lhag pa mi bzhag par gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ mdo rtsar/ gnas pas gnas la ma zhus par bya ba mi bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar dmigs bsal 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa bya ba thams cad zhu zhing*/ dpon slob gnyis ka yon tan mnyam par ma gyur gyi bar du slob pa ste zhib par mdo rtsar blta'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar bla mas bstan pa bzhin du slob mas nyan na/ mtsho la gnas pa'i pad+ma ltar yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur te/ skyes rabs las/ dam pa'i skye bo sus kyang mi bsring ste// dul ba'i tshul gyis dge la bsten par bya// de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul// ched du ma bsgos na yang 'gos par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang mdo bstan bcos rnams las mang du gsungs pas tshul 'di nyid gnad dam par rtogs par bya ste/ slob dpon mi dgos pa'i rang byung gi sangs rgyas gnyis

(9) las ma gsungs pas so// gnyis pa ni/ nyes pa 'byung ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo mi shes pa dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ bag med pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa mang ba rnams yin pas/ de dag gi gnyen por dge ba la spro ba'i brtson 'grus dang*/ 'jug ldog gi gnas la gzob pa'i bag yod/ rang rgyud la nyes pa byung ma byung brtag pa'i shes bzhin rnams bsten dgos te/ bshes spring las/ bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas te bag med pa// 'chi ba'i gnas su thub pas bka' stsal to// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ shes bzhin med pa'i chom rkun dag /dran pa nyams pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// bsod nams dag ni nyer bsags kyang*// rkun pos 'phrog bzhin ngan 'gror 'gro// zhes sogs gsungs pas so// des na rang gi blo gros kyis ci lcogs 'dul ba'i sde snod rnams la thos bsam byed dgos/ de tsam ma nus na'ang sor mdo tsam shes par bya dgos te/ sems ma bsrungs na bslab pa bsrung mi nus shing bsrung bya ma shes na nyes pa mi khegs pas so// de ltar yang rin chen phreng bar/ de nas rab tu byung ba yis// dang por bslab la rab gus bya// so sor thar pa 'dul bcas pa// mang thos don gtan phab la sgrims// zhes so// gsum pa la (10) bzhi ste/ dus dran gyi ngo bo/ de brten dgos pa'i 'thad pa/ gzhi gang la brten pa/ tshul ji ltar brten pa'o// dang po ni/ ston pas bcas pa mdzad pa rnams las gang dang 'gal na'ang bcas ldan rab byung gi rten la nyes par 'gyur ba yin mod/ rkyen dgos dang ldan na 'ga' zhig la ltung ba mi 'byung ba'i dus yod de/ dper na rtswa sngon gcod pa/ me tog 'thog pa sogs la dge slong la ltung ba byung yang*/ mchod rten la byi dor bya ba'i bsam pa dang*/ ston pa mchod pa'i bsam pas de dag byas pa la nyes pa med de sa ga'i lhas/ dge slong la ni mi dge bas// ltung bar 'gyur gyi sems dge na// mchod rten sku las skyes pa yi// rtswa sngon 'thog par byed bzhin du// ji ltar dad pa'i sems kyis ni// ston pa la ni mchod 'dod pas// me tog phreng ba spel ba'i phyir// 'thog pa de la de tsam min// zhes sogs gsungs pa lta bu'o// des na rkyen dgos de 'dra ba byung ba'i tshe gnang ba yin pas nyes pa med do snyam nas dran dgos pa'i don yin no// gnyis pa ni/

ston pas dka' zhing 'tsher ba'i tshe nga'i bslab pa thams cad la bag yangs yod kyis gsungs na'ang*/ ji ltar yod ma gsungs pas des na dus dran brten dgos pa yin/ gal te dus yod na de'i tshe dus dran ma byas (11) kyang nyes pa mi 'byung ngo snyam na/ ma yin te mdo rtsar/ bslab pa thams cad la dus dag yod kyi byin gyis ma brlabs pa la ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas so// 'o na me reg sogs bya ba gang dang gang la 'jug pa de dang de'i tshe dus dran pa dgos sam zhe na/ spyir dgos mod/ 'on kyang dang por bya ba 'di dang 'di la dus dran brten no snyam nas dus ring du byin gyis brlabs na/ phyis 'phral dang 'phral la ma dran yang nyes pa khegs par sems te/ lung las/ mkhan slob sogs kyi don du me la reg pa gnang ba'i tshe dge slong rnams kyis dang po dus dran par byas kyang*/ yang yang brjed nas me la reg pas 'gyod nas gsol bas/ dus ring du byin gyis brlab par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ bkag pa las rkyen stobs kyis gnang ba yod pa zhig ste/ de yang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba rnams ni rang 'dod kyi khri ba zad pa'i byang sems la gnang ba'i dus srid kyang*/ gzhan la srog la bab kyang ma gnang*/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba las chang ma gtogs pa gzhan rnams gnang ba'i dus yod de/ nad pa la gnang bas so// bcas rang gi khyad par ni rab dbye las/ rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba// skye bo kun la sdig par 'gyur// bcas pa'i kha (12) na ma tho ba// bcas pa phyin chad ltung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// rkyen dgos khyad par can med na sla chos mi bya ste/ cho ga btsan po yod na bag yangs la brten par mi bya zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ nangs par bza' btung sogs bya ba gang la yang ma zhugs pa'i thog mar/ da lta dus dbang gis gnang ba'i rkyen can gyi bslab bya 'di dag srung bar ni mi nus shing*/

ma bsrungs na nyes byas phra mo res kyang yun ring por dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong dgos par gsungs pas/ ston pa thugs rje can gyis mi mkhyen pa med cing ston pa 'di snying rje che ba yin pas/ gnang ba zhu bar bya'o snyam pas/ ston pa'i sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rung yod na de'i mdun dang*/ med na'ang rung ste/ ji skad du/ gang zhig sangs rgyas yid byed pa// de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs// gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rnams gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus las nam yang mi yol bas/ 'dir ston pa dngos su bzhugs yod snyam pa'i mos gus bskyed nas phyag gsum 'tshal zhing*/ thal mo sbyar la tsog pur 'dug cing*/ ngag tu/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ de ring gi gnas skabs su chos ldan (13) gyi bya ba dang*/ gzhan gyi don dang*/ rkyen dbang gis glu gar dang rol mo la sogs pa byed dam byed du 'jug pa dang*/ me la reg gam reg tu 'jug pa dang*/ sa bon bcom pa dang bcom du gzhug pa dang*/ skye ba gcod pa dang gcod du 'jug pa dang*/ sa rko ba dang rkor bcug pa dang*/ lag nya dang mtshams btsos dang rjen btsos dang zhag lon dang*/ byin len ma byas par za ba dang*/ gsog 'jog byas te za ba la sogs pa mdor na dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum las/ dus dran brten du rung ba rnams ston pa thugs rje can gyis bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ dge tshul yin na gzhan 'dra ba la/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi bas de ring gi gnas skabs su chos ldan gyi bya ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don dang*/ rkyen dbang gis glu gar dang rol mo la sogs pa byed dam byed du 'jug pa dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas za ba la sogs pa mdor na dge tshul gyi bslab par bya ba rnams las dus dran brten du rung ba rnams ston pa thugs rje can gyis gnang bar mdzad du gsol// zhes de ltar brjod pas/

ston pas bdag la gnang ba byin snyam du yid ches bskyed/ da lta sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub la nye/ sems can gyi bde skyid zad/ mi srun (14) pa'i skye bos gang ba'i dus 'dir/ sngon gyi dge slong lta bu mi 'byung bas/ 'di lta bu'i thabs du mas bslab bya bsrung sdom la ma 'bad na nyin re bzhin nyes ltung gi char 'bab par 'dug pas tshul 'di lta bu la brtson par kun la snying nas gsol ba 'debs so// mi lus thob kyang mi tshe g.yeng bas zad// dam chos thos kyang yid ches nor gyis dbul/ kha bshad shes kyang nyams su ma lon pa// skal ngan bdag ni lhar bcas snying rje'i gnas// zhes kyang smras so// bzhi pa la/ dge tshul gyi bslab bya ni bye brag bshad pa las/ 'chang ba dang ni 'bral ba dang*// de bzhin sa ni rko ba dang*// rin chen reg dang me la reg /spang ba za dang sa bon 'jig /ljon shing 'dzeg dang shing gcod dang*// byin len ma byas za ba dang*// rtswa sngon mi gtsang 'dor ba dang*// de bzhin gsog 'jog za ba ste// bcu gnyis rnams ni ma gtogs pa// zhes gsungs pa'i 'chang ba la gnyis su phye ba'i bcu gsum dang*/ 'dul 'dzin rnams kyis rung mthun sbyar ba/ zla 'jog gsog 'jog dgon par 'bral// ma smras 'dun bsgyur ma rdzogs nyal// zhes pa drug dang bcu dgu las gzhan dge slong gi bslab bya gang dang 'gal na dge tshul la yang phyogs mthun gyi nyes pa bskyed cing*/ blang 'das kyi rkang grangs tsam ni nyes ltung

(15) spyi bshags su gsal bas 'dir ma smos la/ dge slong gis shes nas spang bar bya ba la ltung ba sde lnga las/ 'di dag gi dbye ba zhib tu bshad na/ bslab pa 'cha' ba'i snyad ka gleng gzhi/ bcas pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ltung ba'i rgyu tshogs/ gzhi bsam pa sbyor ba mthar thug gi yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ yan lag ma tshang na sbom po dang nyes byas su 'gyur tshul/ ltung ba'i sbom po'i lci yang sogs du ma yod cing*/ sde lngar ma 'dus pa'i sbom po dang nyes byas kyang du ma yod mod/ rgyas par bshad na yi ge mang bas 'jigs pas/ 'dir tshig tshogs nyung ba la 'bad par byas/ de la spyi'i grangs la nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir sdom tshig bkod nas 'byung nye ba 'ga' zhig bye brag tu 'chad pa'i dbang du byas te/ de la sde tshan dang po'i sdom tshig ni/ mi tshangs spyod dang rku ba dang*// mi la bsad par mi bya ba// rdzun du smra dang bcas pa yi// chos bzhi 'dir ni gsungs pa yin// zhes so// de dag las khyad par du ma byin len gyi pham pa 'di nyid 'byung nye ba yin/ rin thang gi tshad la du ma gsungs mod/ dngul skya zho gang gi brgyad cha brkus na pham par gsungs pas rin thang tshang sla/ dngos po dman pa rtswa shing lta bu yin yang rin thang tshang na pham par 'gyur te/ dge slong nor can gyis shing brkus nas (16) bcas pas so// bsam pa'i khyad par 'jig rten na rku ba dngos kyi tha snyad mi byed pa/ gzhan gyi rdzas brnyas te phyir mi sbyin pa dang*/ rang gi nor rkun pos khyer ba phyis phyir 'phrog na pham par gsungs pa dang*/ gdeng yod bzhin du skugs btsug ste nor thob na pham par lung rnam 'byed las gsungs zhes mtsho ṭīka tu bshad/ sde tshan gnyis pa'i sdom ni/ khu ba 'dzin dang 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur smyan// khang pa khang chen dang ni gzhi med dang*// bag tsam dge 'dun dbyen dang de rjes phyogs// khyim sun 'byin dang bka' blo mi bde ba'o// zhes so// smyan gyi lhag ma 'di khyo shugs 'thab par gyur pa bsam bzang du rlom nas 'dum par byas na'ang 'byung zhing*/

'di dang 'di gnyen du byas na ci 'ong zer nas dri ba la/ de ltar byas na legs tshul sogs brjod mi nyan par 'dug lags/ so thar dang lung du ma nges pa gnyis zhes 'byung yang*/ dang po pham lhag ltung byed gsum du ma nges shing*/ gnyis pa lhag ma dang ltung byed gnyis su ma nges pas mdo rtsar sde tshan zur du ma mdzad pas/ 'dir yang sde tshan lngar byas pa'i gsum pa ltung byed kyi sde la gnyis/ zhag gi chad las dang 'brel ba spang ltung gi sde/ bshags pa tsam dang 'brel ba ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa'i sde'o// dang po la dka' gnad spyir bshad pa/ ngo bo'i (17) grangs sdom gyis bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dir shan gyi mtha' cung zad dpyad na/ rdzas shan spyi'i ngo bo/ bye brag so so'i shan brdeg tshul/ ltung shan brdeg tshul/ shan 'dre ba'i dus/ gang gis gang la brdeg pa lnga las/ dang po ni/ shan rdeg byed kyi rdzas la bdag 'dzin zhugs pa des/ brdeg bya'i rdzas la gos par byas nas brdeg bya des rang stobs kyis ltung ba bskyed pa'i dus min yang gzhan stobs kyis ltung ba bskyed pa'i rigs su byed pa'o// gnyis pa la/ gos lhung bzed sman shan brdeg tshul lo// dang po la 'chang 'jog gi shan brdeg tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'dir rdzas shan dang zhag shan so sor ma phye bar thun mong du dper brjod na/ dper na tshes gcig la 'khor gsum khebs pa'i gos tshad dang ldan pa'am kha skong gi re ba med na khru gang gi tshad du langs pa'i gos rnyed pa byin gyis ma brlabs par bzhag na/ tshes gnyis nas bcu'i bar gang rung la gos gnyis pa rnyed pa de la byin rlabs byas rung ma byas rung*/ tshes bcu gcig gi skya rengs shar tshe/ snga mas rang stobs dang phyi mas gzhan stobs kyis ltung ba gnyis bskyed pa lta bu'o// 'on kyang rdzas shan la gos snga phyi'i bar du zhag gis ma chod kyang shan brdeg pa yod do// gnyis pa ni/ chos gos rnam gsum gang

(18) rung med pa'i gang zag gis// kha skong gi re ba dang bcas te khru gang gi tshad dang ldan pa'i gos tshes gcig lta bu la rnyed nas byin gyis ma brlabs par bzhag tshes gnyis nas sum cu'i bar la de lta bu'i gos gnyis pa rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs ma brlabs gang ltar yang rung ste/ so gcig pa'i skya rengs shar tshe zla 'jog gi ltung ba gnyis bskyed pa'o// 'di la rigs log shan 'byung ba/ rigs log shan mi 'byung ba/ rigs mi bzlog shan mi 'byung ba/ rigs mi bzlog shan 'byung ba'i mu bzhi yod pa cung zad bshad na/ dang po ni/ tshes gcig la khru gang gi tshad du langs pa'i gos gcig rnyed/ gnyis nas bcu'i bar gang rung la gos yongs rdzogs rnyed nas kha skong gi re ba chad na/ gos snga ma de rigs log shan 'byung gi gos yin te/ sngar zla 'jog gi gos rigs yin pa la da zhag bcu pa'i gos rigs su gyur pa dang*/ tshes bcu gcig pa'i skya rengs shar tshe gos snga phyi rim bzhin rang stobs dang gzhan stobs kyis 'chang ltung bskyed pas so// gnyis pa ni/ tshe gcig gi snga dro'i dus su khru gang gi tshad du langs pa'i gos rnyed nas/ phyi dro'i dus su gos yongs rdzogs rnyed na gos snga ma rigs log shan mi 'byung ba'i yin te/ kha skong gi re ba chad pas rigs log la/ nyin gcig la rnyed pa zhag shan mi (19) brdeg pas so// 'on kyang rdzas shan mi brdeg pa'i nges pa med do// gsum pa ni/ tshes gcig la tshad snga ma lta bu'i gos rnyed de nas kha skong gi gos gzhan ma rnyed na/ zhag so gcig pa'i skya rengs shar tshe gos de rigs ma log shan mi 'byung gi gos yin te/ kha skong gi re ba ma chad pa dang shan brdeg bya med pas so// bzhi pa ni/ tshes gcig la gos sngar lta bu rnyed nas tshes gnyis nas sum cu'i bar gang rung la gos khru gang gi tshad du langs pa gzhan zhig rnyed na/ snga ma de rigs ma log shan 'byung gi gos yin te/

kha skong gi re ba mi chad pas dang shan brdeg bya yod pas so// gnyis pa ni/ gos dang lhung bzed 'don pa brjes nas zhag bcu pa'i skabs ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa la thun tshod du rung ba'i dang*/ zhag bdun pa'i sman shan brdeg tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snga dro'i dus su thun tshod du rung ba'i sman rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs nas bzhag de dang lhan cig tu rnyed pa yin na byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang*/ phyis nas rnyed pa yin na byin gyis brlabs kyang rung thun tshod kyi mtha' las 'das tshe sngar byin gyis brlabs pa des rang stobs dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis shan stobs kyis gsog 'jog gi ltung ba bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshes gcig la (20) bu ram gyi sman rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs nas bzhag de dang mnyam du rnyed pa yin na byin gyis ma brlabs pa dang*/ nyin phyi ma rnams su rnyed pa byin gyis brlabs pa yin yang rung ste/ zhag brgyad pa'i skya rengs shar tshe dang po byin gyis brlabs pa des rang stobs dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis shan stobs kyis ltung ba bskyed pa'o// 'dir rdzas shan dang zhag shan so sor ma bshad kyang shes sla'o// gsum pa ni/ rang la spang ltung gang byung ba de'i rgyur gyur gyi dngos po spang dgos su gnas pa'i shan des phyis rnyed kyi yo byad rigs mthun mi mthun thams cad spang bar bya dgos pa nyid du byed pa yin/ 'o na bshags pa byed pa'i tshe phyis rnyed kyi rdzas thams cad spang dgos sam zhe na/ gos khru gang bas dman pa dang*// rin thang de tsam mi ri ba dang*/ lhung bzed tshad las chung ba/ zas mgul du mid pa mi mngon pa'i chung ngu rnams spang mi dgos te/ spang rin med pa'i phyir zhes rin phreng du gsungs/ ltung shan 'di lung rigs gter mdzod du/ yo byad la zhen pa'i dbang gis byung ba phyir bcos ma byas pa la brten nas ltung ba'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal skyed byed kyi nus pa 'phel ba'i stobs kyis ltung ba phyi ma'i nus pa gong 'phel byed pa yin zhes gsungs/

des na ltung ba byung nas 'phral dang 'phral la bshags pa ma byas nas yun ring du (21) lus na bshags pas 'dag dka' zhes gsungs pa'i gnad de lags so// bzhi pa ni/ rdzas shan 'dre dus shan brdeg bya de nam grub pa na yin zhing*/ ltung shan 'dre dus phyis rnyed kyi rdzas grub ma thag tu'am yang na ltung ba phyi ma byung ba na yin no// lnga pa ni/ gos 'chang ba zla 'jog lhung bzed 'chang ba gsum gyi skabs su bcas rigs mthun pa dgos pas/ gos shan gyis lhung bzed la mi brdeg la/ gsog 'jog gi skabs su nang tshan rigs mthun dgos pas bu ram gyi shan gyis bu ram la brdeg gi mar la mi brdeg de yi rgyu mtshan 'di nad pa la gnang bas cung zad bag yangs mdzad pa lags/ byin gyis ma brlabs pas brlabs pa la brdeg pa'i skabs su snga ma dang dus mnyam pas brdeg gi phyi mas mi brdeg ma brlabs pa nang mnyam pa lta bu la brdeg pa'i skabs snga mas phyi ma la brdeg gi dus mnyam pas kyang mi brdeg sman la byin gyis brlabs pas ma brlabs pa dang brlabs pa la brdeg gi byin gyis ma brlabs pas gzhan la mi brdeg pa yin/ ltung shan rdeg byed spang ltung gang rung yin pas/ de'i rgyur gyur gyi dngos po spang dgos su gnas pa'i shan des/ brdeg bya phyis rnyed kyi dngos po rigs mthun mi mthun gyi yo byad rnams sam/ yang na ltung ba snga mas sems (22) rgyud la yod pa'i ltung ba phyi ma gzhan la'o// 'di dag gi lung sbyor rnams yi ges 'jigs pas ma bkod kyang*/ nor 'khrul med pas yid ches mdzad 'tshal/ mdor na spang ltung byung ba'i rgyur gyur gyi rdzas de rgyun du bcangs na/ de phyin chad zhag re la ltung ba re 'byung bar gsungs pas gong du bshad pa'i shan 'jug mi 'jug gi dbye ba la mkhas par byas nas/ rang dbang ba'i gos khru gang ba yan chod bsam pa thag pas gzhan la bsngo ba'am/ 'chad 'gyur bzhin byin gyis brlabs pa sogs ma byas na/

ltung ba 'byung rung gi gos grangs bcu dang ldan pa'i dge slong zhig la lo re bzhin 'chang ltung 'di kho na la'ang sum stong drug brgya re tsam nyung mtha' 'byung bar 'dug pas nyes pa 'di dag mi 'byung ba'i thabs la cis kyang brtson dgos/ de ltar mi byed par de 'dra'i chos brgyad byas pas ci yang mi 'ong zer ba de 'dra mi gsung bar zhu/ gnyis pa la'ang bcu tshan gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'chang ba 'bral ba 'jog pa dang*// 'khrur 'jug pa dang len pa dang*/ slong dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bcas// rin thang so sor bskur ba'o// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ srin bal 'ba' zhig cha gnyis dang*// drug dang mtho gang lam dang ni// 'khru ba dang ni gser dngul dang*// mngon mtshan can dang nyo tshong (23) ngo*// zhes so// 'di'i dang po gsum rtsol sgrub ma byas par rnyed na ltung ba med de/ gzhan las rab tu thob pa ni// ci bde bar yang yongs su spyad// ces so// rtsol sgrub byas na ni dngos po bzang po gzhan gyis stan byas na'ang ltung ba skyed do// gser dngul gyi spang ba 'di rung ba byas na mi 'byung la/ dgos ched gang la na/ chos gos lam rgyags nad pa yi// sman gyi rgyur ni ma gtogs so// zhes pa ltar ro// de ci ltar bya na/ rung ba byed pa'i tshul gsum mdo rtsar gsungs te/ dang po ni sbyin bdag bdag po nyid du mos su bcug nas de la yid gtad de 'chang ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni zhal ta ba bdag por mos su bcug nas 'chang ba'o// gsum pa sngags kyis rung ba byed tshul ni/ rin po che dngos dang der smos pa zangs sogs la'ang byin brlab bya bar gsungs pas/ rdzas de dge slong gi mdun du bzhag yul rten gnyis ka 'grengs te yul rang gi mdun gyi bar snang la lag pa brkyangs nas/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di rnyed de/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'di byin gyis brlab bo// dngos po rung ba ma lags pa 'dis dngos po rung ba bsgrub par

(24) bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ ngag tu brjod pa bzhin yid kyis bsam mo// yul dge slong med na mdun du 'phags pa mau gal bu lta bu bzhugs par bsam la lha dgongs su gsol zhes brjod gzhan ni 'dra/ dge tshul yin na bdag shākya'i dge tshul zhes 'don pa brje ba ma gtogs 'dra/ dge tshul gyis dus dran byed pa dang rung ba byed pa'i tshul 'di dag rang bzo yin no zhe na/ 'di la rgyu mtshan yod de spyir dge slong la bag yangs yod na dge tshul la'ang bang yangs 'byung rigs pa dang*/ dge tshul gyi bslab bya rnams la nyes med kyi dus mang du gsungs pas des na dus dran brten dgos la/ sngags tshig ngag tu brjod pa 'di rang gi dran pa gso ba'i thabs khyad par can yin pas so// 'dis yid gtad yul de rab tu byung ba ma yin pa zhig dgos so// gzhan dge slong gis 'chang mi rung ba thag khra bo sogs kyang khyim pa la yid gtad de 'chang bar gsungs so// gnang ba ji ltar yod ce na/ kā ri kā sum brgya pa las/ chos sgrog byed pa'i glu la nyes pa med/ ston pa'i yon tan sgrog pa'ang de bzhin no// zhes dang*/ nad pas dben par 'dug nas bsku bya ste// dad ldan dag gis rkang par spos byug na// sbyin bdag gis ni lkog tu bkru bar bya// zhes dang*/ khyim (25) pas rin chen 'od 'bar byas byin na'ang*// mi rtag nyid du bsgoms la 'dug par bya// zhes dang*/ nad pa la ni mkhas pa'i lung nyid dus// phongs pa la ni dus min med pa yin// dngul dang gser gyi rnam pa len byed na// nyes byas 'gyur ro gos dang rgyags phyir dang*// lus kyi phyir dang de bzhin sman phyir dang*// chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ni nyes pa med// ces sogs gsungs la de'i 'grel pa 'od ldan du rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pas shes par 'dod na der blta bar bya'o// nyo tshong byed pa'i ltung byed la/

mngon mtshan can dang nyo tshong gi ltung ba 'di gnyis kyi khyad par ni/ khe 'dod pas pa ṇa sogs skyed du gtong ba dang po/ gzhan gang yang rung ba nyo tshong byed pa phyi ma yin/ yang na rin po che mngon mtshan can skyed du gtong ba dang gzhan 'bru sogs kyi nyo tshong byed pa phyi ma yin no// spyir nyo tshong byed pa bkag kyang dmigs bsal dge 'dun gyi ched dam/ rang gi chos gos sogs nyo dgos shing thabs gzhan gyis mi 'grub na rang gi blo tshod kyis rin thang btab nas pha rol po la 'di tsam gyis chog gam/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas nyo ba la nyes pa med de/ gal te nyo byed sgrin po 'ga' med na// tshig ni gsum gyi bar du brjod par bya// zhes so// (26) de las gzhan khe 'dod pas nyo tshong byed na ltung bar 'gyur la/ g.yo tshong byas nas khe thob na brkus pa dngos yin par gsungs pas pham pa yang 'byung bas des na 'di la skyon du lta ba las yon tan du rlom par mi bya/ gsum pa ni/ lhung bzed gnyis dang tha ga gnyis// byin 'phrog ston zla tha chung dang*// dgon pa ba dang ras chen dang*// bsngos pa dang ni gsog 'jog go /zhes so// lhung bzed byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ sman cung zad blugs la yul rten gnyis ka'i lag g.yon 'og dang g.yas pas steng nas bkab la/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas lhung bzed zas la spyad par 'os pa drang srong gi snod 'di slong ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab bo// lan gsum brjod cing thabs legs bya'o// gsog 'jog gi spang ba 'di'i gleng gzhir zhag bdun pa gsog 'jog byas pa la brten nas bcas par mdzad/ bam po lnga bcu pa las zhag bdun pa las sman gzhan rang dus las 'das par bcangs na'ang nyes byas su gsungs/ mkhas pa gzhan ni sman gzhan gyis kyang ltung ba 'di skyed par bzhed do// 'di'i nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i thabs la dus dran brten pa dang*/
rung khang byin gyis brlabs na der mtshams btsos dang zhag lon dang gsog 'jog byas pa'i nyes pa khegs par

(27) gsungs pas/ de'i tshul la dge 'dun gyi rung khang byin gyis rlob pa'i tshul gzhan du shes la/ 'dir gang zag gi rung khang bya tshul 'dul 'dzin snga ma'i phyag len bzhin brjod na/ bza' bca'i rigs rnams rung khang du 'jog yul yod tshe rang gis dge sbyor bya ba'i mtshams khang byin rlabs bya mi rung yang*/ 'jog yul med na gnyis kar byin rlabs bya dgos/ de yang yul rten gnyis ka mchil l+h+wam phud nas yul de bslab pa rgan na phyag gsum bya/ gzhon na thang shad byas nas gnyis ka 'grengs te yul de mkhan po yin na de dang slob dpon yin na slob dpon zhes brjod/ min na dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rung khang byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu zhes brjod/ yul gyis chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin gyis shig ces brjod/ de nyid kyis btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bslab pa la ma gus pa ma lags so// ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mkhyen pa dang ldan/ gzigs pa dang ldan pa de rnams kyis rung ba'i khang pa dang zas kyi khang par yongs su longs spyod par mkhyen cing gzigs pa de ltar na 'di bdag gi phyir dran pa nye bar 'jog go /des bdag gi tshangs par spyod pa rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod/ thabs (28) legs byas/ de nas gtang rag gi phyag byas nas dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po rung khang byin gyis rlob pa'i cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che lags zhes dang*/ yul gyis chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin byas pa la rjes su yi rang zhes brjod/ gnyis kas khrims kyi tshul khrims sogs brjod/ de yang rung khang gang gi yin pa'i dge slong med par zhag gcig 'da' bar byas na 'di'i rung ba bag yangs su 'gyur bar rin phreng du gsungs/ gnyis pa ltung byed kyi sde la bcu tshan dgu las/ dang po ni/ rdzun skyon dge slong phra ma dang*// skyo sngogs byed dang ston pa dang*// 'don dang gnas ngan len dang chos// bshes ngor byed dang khyad du gsod// ces so// gnyis pa ni/

sa bon 'phya ba sgo ba dang*// khri dang gding dang skrod pa dang*// phyis gnon 'byung ba 'debs pa dang*// rim pa gnyis su rtsig pa'o// zhes so// sa bon dang skye ba 'jig pa'i ltung byed 'di gzhom bya'i rdzas ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi ltung ba 'byung yang rung ba byas na nyes pa med/ de yang gro nas lta bu la mes rung ba bya tshul ni/ de dag phung por byas te phyogs gnyis sam gsum nas mes reg tsam byas na de dge slong gis bcom yang nyes pa med/ 'on kyang dge slong gis rung ba byas na de la ltung ba yod par bshad/ rjen btsos su yang 'gyur ro// des na rung ba byed pa po dge tshul man (29) chad cig dgos/ sbyin bsreg gi rdzas la rung ba ma byas kyang theg pa gong 'og gi khyad par dang*/ dgos pa dang dgag bya che chung gis nyes pa med par gsungs/ rung ba byas na'ang yon tan las ci yod// mes rung ba 'di byed du bcug pa la nyes pa med dam snyam/ mdo rtsar/ rung bar byed pa yod na sngo bskrabam̐ par byed du gzhug go /zhes khang thog gi sngo 'thog tu bcug pa la nyes pa med par gsungs pas so// gsum pa ni/ ma bskos nyi ma nub pa dang*// zas dang chos gos gnyis dag dang*// don mthun gru dang dben pa gnyis// dge slong ma yis sbyor bcug pa'o// zhes so// 'di dag 'byung mi nye yang bsrung sems med na ltung ba ma byung ba tsam du zad kyis srung ba'i phan yon thob dka' snyam mo// bzhi pa ni/ yang yang dang ni 'dug gnas gcig /phye dang bca' dang stob pa dang*// 'dus dang dus min gsog 'jog dang*// kha nas mid dang bsod pa nyid// ces so// spang za'i ltung byed 'di lhag por byas na mi 'byung*/ de'i tshul ni/ yul dge slong zas kyi gnas ma btang ba zhig dgos/ rang nyid kyis zas rung ba byin len byas pa de yul gyi mdun du bzhag la phyag byas nas/ mdun thad drang por 'dug cing*/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/

bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba 'tshal ma 'tshal lags (30) shing spang bar bgyis pa las/ bza' bar bya ba rnyed cing 'tshal bar 'tshal na lhag por bgyis te bdag la stsal du gsol zhes lan gcig brjod/ yul gyis zas de lag tu blangs shing kham gnyis sam gsum zos nas/ ci bder gsol cig ces brjod nas de la sbyin/ yul de zas spangs zin na mi za bar tshig tsam gyis lhag por bya/ lhag por byas pa'i zas de zas spangs pa gzhan gyis kyang bza' rung bar gsungs/ 'on kyang nad pa dang mu ge'i dus su lhag por ma byas kyang nyes pa med par gsungs so// dus ma yin par za ba'i ltung byed la/ zan dang shing thog sogs dus rung gi bza' bca'i rigs las sman gzhan gsum ni byin gyis brlabs na phyi dro yang bza' rung ste/ ston pas grong khyer bzang byed du khyim bdag lug la sogs pa btul ba'i tshe/ lug gis zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba na/ dus yol gyi dus min gyi zas sta gon gyis gsungs/ dus min du rung ba ci lags zhus pas mar dang bu ram dang*/ hags dang sha kha ra dang*/ btung ba'o// zhes gsungs pas so// zho ni 'thung du mi rung ste// u pa li zho ni snga dro ba'o// zho'i kha chu ni phyi dro ba'o// zhes gsungs shing*/ hu lu hu lu yi rang dang*// kun spyod snod dang lan tshwa dang*// lam dang sor gnyis dkrugs dang gding*// gser gyi rung ba dag (31) dang bcu// zhes mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu'i ya gyal kyang yin pas so// gsog 'jog byas pa za ba'i ltung byed 'di/ gsog 'jog gi nyes pa khegs na mi 'byung bas/ sngar bshad pa ltar dus dran sogs la 'bad/ lag nya sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i thabs su zan gcod par byed pa'i tshul la/ bsam pa bdag ltung ba dang bcas te gson pa bas deng nyid shi ba sla'o snyam pa dang smon 'jug gi sems gnyis gsal btab nas sbyor ba nyin dang por zan gcod cing ja yang mi btung*/

nyin gnyis pa la zan spar gang dang ja phor pa gang btung*/ nyin gsum pa la zan spar do dang ja yang phor pa do btung*/ bzhi pa la ji tsam gyis chog pa de tsam bza' zhing btung ngo*// de yang lto 'dun gyis ma yin par lus kyi srin bu gso ba chos dang sgrub pa'i rten 'tsho ba la dmigs nas longs spyad par gsungs pas btung ba ma bcad na zan gcod kyi go mi chod pa ma yin/ rgya ja'i btung ba 'di 'dul 'dzin snga ma 'ga' zhig thun tshon du rung ba'i sman gyi khongs su gtogs par bzhed cing*/ lung las zan bcad par gsungs kyi btung ba bcad par ma gsungs/ 'dis gsog 'jog gi nyes pa'ang khegs pas/ des na gsog 'jog gi nyes pa 'byung ba'i gzhi thams cad spang dgos pas ja mi btung ba'i gnad de yin par gsungs/ (32) zan gcod byed pa po dge tshul yin na btung ba bcad mi dgos/ dge tshul gyis zan gcod byed dgos par gzhung nas dngos su ma gsungs kyang don gyis thob pas rgyun du dgung gcod mi nus pa rnams kyis zan gcod byas na legs/ gnyis pa de'i phan yon ni shing thog sogs rung ba ma byas pa dang*/ byin len ma byas pa za ba dang*/ la phug sogs rtsa ba'i rigs dbyung nas 'tshed pa sogs byed pa dang*/ phyi dro za ba rnams la nyes pa med par gsungs so// 'on kyang 'di dag zas med cing shin tu bkres pa'i dus lta bu la gnang ba yin gyi skabs thams cad du ma yin no// byin len byed pa'i tshul ni/ byin len stob pa po zas de gyen du 'degs nus pa'i bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa zhig gis mdun thad drang por zas de bzung nas/ rang gi lag pa gnyis gan rkyal du bkan/ sems lag pa dang 'brel ba'i lhung bzed sogs kyis 'di ni sbyin pa'o// bdag ni len pa'o snyam nas len pa yin/ dmigs bsal byin len byas pa'i zas gzhan med cing*/ byin len stob pa po'ang med na/ rang dbang ba'i zas blangs te sgra mi snyan gyi dus su byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod pa nyes pa med de/

zhu bar/ byang gi sgra mi snyan pa'i dus su byin gyis brlabs na ltung ba med do// zhes gsungs so// de'i rgyu mtshan yang yul der longs spyod la nga khyod (33) pa dang*/ dge sdig gi byed po sems yin pa'i gnad kyis so// byin len 'jig pa'i rgyu ni/ 'phrog dang 'dril dang reg pa dang*// bsngos dang dge slong min gyur dang*// ngo bo gyur dang skye ba gyur// dor ba yis ni byin len 'jig /ces pa ltar ro// lnga pa ni/ srog chags dang bcas nyal sar 'dug /'greng dang gcer bu dmag dang ni// zhag gnyis bshams dkrug 'gro ba dang*// brdeg dang gzas dang gnas ngan len// ces so// drug pa ni/ bde dang me dang 'dun pa dang*// bsnyen par ma rdzogs chos gtam smra// dge tshul kha dog ma bsgyur dang*// rin po che dang tsha ba'i dus// zhes so// nub lhag nyal gyi nyes pa 'gog pa la rang dang bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa gnyis kyi bar du khru phyed dang dgu'am gnas khang spyod lam bzhi shong ba'i tshad tsam gyis bar chod na/ nyes pa mi 'byung bar gsungs/ rkyen dbang gis lhan cig nyal dgos pa byung na ska rags dang thag pas sam sa la ri mo bris te bar bcad na nub lhag gi nyes pa thub par sngon gyi 'dul 'dzin 'ga' zhig bzhed ces thos na'ang*/ 'di gnas brtan pa dang mang bkur sde pa gnyis kyi lugs yin pas sde pa tha dad yin pa'i phyir nyes pa khegs mi khegs kha tshon chod dka' mod/ 'on kyang bslab bya yal bar bor ba dang ni gtan mi mtshungs te (34) khyad gsod ma byas pa'i phyir ro// des na rkyen de lta bu'i tshe ska rags sogs kyis bar gcod pa de legs par sems so// kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos gyon pa'i ltung byed 'di/ gos khru gang ba yan chad ci yang rung ba tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba'i gos gzhan gyis g.yogs ma med par gyon na tha na lhung bzed kyi kha g.yogs tsam la kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos longs spyod na'ang ltung ba 'di 'byung ba yin/

'di'i bcas pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan khyim pa dang rtags 'dre ba/ bya ba ma yin par byed pa/ gzhan ma dad par gyur pa rnams yin pas dgag bya rdzogs mi rdzogs dpyad nas rang gi ji nus kyis spang blang byed pa dang*/ ston pa snying rje che ba yin pas dus dran brten pa gal che/ rin po che la reg pa'i ltung byed ni nor bu la sogs pa'i rin po che dngos dang der smos pa dung la sogs pa'i rol mo dang*/ ral gri sogs mtshon cha la'ang reg na ltung ba der 'gyur bas 'di 'byung nye bas bag yod mdzad 'tshal/ gal te reg dgos pa'i rkyen byung na dkon mchog mchod pa dang*/ yo byad chud za ba skyob pa'i bsam pa dang ma 'bral ba zhig dgos so// bdun pa ni/ dud 'gro 'gyod pa sor mo dang*// rtse dang lhan cig sdangs byed dang*// sbed dang gdeng med gzhi med dang*// skyes pa med par lam 'gro ba'o// zhes so// bud med dang lhan (35) cig nyal ba'i ltung byed ni/ bud med bdag pos srung ba'am// rang la khrims grogs gzhan yod na ltung ba 'di mi 'byung yang*/ nub gnyis las lhag par nyal na nub lhag gi ltung ba 'byung zhing*/ de khyo shugs lta bu yin na nyal shom gyi khyim na 'dug pa'i ltung ba'ang 'byung nye'o// brgyad pa ni/ rku dang nyi shu ma lon dang*// rko dang mgron dang bslab pa dang*// 'thab dang mi smra 'gro ba dang*// mi gus chang 'thung dus min pa'o// zhes so// dgu pa ni/ zas bcas skya rengs da gdod dang*// khab ral dang ni khri rkang dang*// brdal dang gding dang g.yan pa dang*// ras chen bde gshegs chos gos so// zhes so// bzhi pa sor bshags kyi sde ni/ grong dang khyim gzhan nyid dang ni// bslab pa rnams dang dgon pa ni// sangs rgyas phan par mdzad pa yis// so sor bshags par bya bar gsungs// zhes so// lnga pa nyes byas kyi sde ni/ sham thabs la ni rnam pa bdun// stod g.yogs la yang rnam gsum dang*/

shin tu bsdams la sogs pa lnga// mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga// mchongs la sogs pa rnam lnga dang*// lus la sogs pa rnam pa lnga// 'dug par bya ba dgu dag dang*// byin len bya ba brgyad rnams so// zas la legs par bya ba drug /tsug tsug la sogs rnam pa (36) lnga// 'bru nas tha dad byed pa lnga// lag pa ldag la sogs pa lnga// 'phya la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi// lhung bzed la yang rnam pa bcu// 'greng bar byed la sogs pa lnga// mgo g.yogs la sogs rnam pa lnga// do ker can la sogs pa lnga// glang chen la sogs zhon pa lnga// lag na 'khar ba la sogs drug /na ba rnam pa bzhi rnams so// zhes pa ltar ro// lnga pa bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i sgo nas bsrung ba la gsum/ gso sbyong*/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye'o// dang po la/ sgra don dbye ba phan yon gsum// dang po ni/ gnyen po bslab pa gso zhing spang bya sdig pa sbyong bas na gso sbyong zhes bya'o// gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong ni/ las sgrib sbyong ba'i ched du/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam dag la brten nas sde snod la thos bsam byas te/ de'i don bsgom pa'i nyams len te/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas// sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor// zhes so// gnyis pa mthun pa'i gso sbyong la lnga ste/ de'ang tshe 'di'i zag pa 'phel ba'i rkyen la/ ltung ba gnod pa rtsod pa bkra mi shes pa bzhi las/ dang po'i gnyen po dus kyi sgo nas bcu bzhi dang bco lnga pa gnyis gsungs te/ de'ang hor zla dang po gsum pa lnga pa bdun pa dgu pa bcu gcig pa rnams kyi mar ngo la bcu bzhi pa dang*/ dus gzhan bco brgyad po rnams (37) la bco lnga pa bya ba yin no// phyi ma gsum gyi gnyen por rim bzhin gnod pa bzlog pa/ rtsod pa bsdum pa/ bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong rnams dbye bar mdzad do// 'dir skabs su mkho ba 'dun dag 'bul tshul dang*/ gso sbyong byin rlabs kyi sngags 'dir bri na/

de yang 'dun dag gnyis gcig char 'bul ba'i sngags ni/ tshe dang ldan pa dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso sbyong yang bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi chos rnams kyis dag go zhes bdag mchi'o// dge 'dun chos bzhin du mdzad pa la 'dun pa 'bul lo// bdag gso sbyong yang yongs su dag go /'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa yang brjod do// brjod pa yang rig par bgyid do zhes lan gsum brjod/ de yang 'dun pa 'bul ba ni las la 'dun pa 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ yongs dag 'bul ba ni bdag nyid kyi gso sbyong nyams su myong ba'i ched yin par gsungs/ gso sbyong byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ gso sbyong gi tshe rang las gzhan med na 'dug la/ lha dgongs su gsol/ deng dge 'dun gyi gso sbyong bco lnga pa lags la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gso sbyong yang bco lnga pa lags te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba bar chad kyi (38) chos rnams kyis yongs su dag go /zhes bdag mchi na bdag yongs su dag par lha rnams kyis gzung du gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ deng gso sbyong byin gyis brlab bo// gang gi tshe dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rnyed pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong rgya cher nyams su myong bar bya zhing*/ so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pa'ang gdon par bgyi'o// lan gsum brjod cing bsam mo// grogs dge slong gzhan yod na de'i mdun du byin gyis brlabs/ dge tshul yin na gzhan 'dra ba la dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa de'i tshe dge 'dun dang lhan cig gso sbyong nyams su myong bar bya zhing bgyi'o zhes brjod/ dge tshul gyi gso sbyong byin rlabs byed pa 'di nges par dgos te/ gso sbyong ma byas na nyes byas 'byung bar 'od ldan las/

dgag dbye las nyams pa ni sdom pa nyams pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa yin zhing de bzhin du gso sbyong las nyams pa'ang yin no zhes gsungs la/ gso sbyong byin gyis brlabs na nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gso sbyong byin rlabs byed pa'i thog mar phyir bcos re mdzad na legs par sems/ gso sbyong byin rlabs tsam yang ma grub na/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis tsam brjod pas kyang gso sbyong gi go chod par mkhas pa phal cher bzhed do//

(39) gsum pa ni bslab gsum gong 'phel du byed pa'i sgo nas gnas skabs mngon mtho dang mthar thug nges legs thob pa dang*/ khyad par du ston pa'i bcas pa dang mthun zhing*/ sa phyogs bkra shis pa dang*/ yul de na gnas pa'i skye bo mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gsungs so// gnyis pa dbyar gnas pa la dgos pa ni/ thos bsam bsgom gsum 'phel ba/ gtsug lag khang ral grum bcos pa/ rang gzhan gyi lus srog la gnod pa dang*/ gzhan gyis kha zer ba dang*/ don dang bya ba mang ba rnams spang ba dang*/ ston pa'i bcas pa dang mthun pa ste/ mdor na 'di la brten nas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don rnams 'grub pa'i ched du'o// gsum pa dgag dbye la'ang dgos pa ni/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i ched du/ ltung ba gleng dran la brten nas ltung ba la bshags sdom byed pa dang*/ chos rnam par dag pa'i ched du ltung ba'i ngo bo 'bel gtam gyi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ bye brag rdzas kyi dgag dbye'i dgos pa ni rnyed pa'i sgo dbye ba'i ched du ste/ dgag dbye byas pa'i dge 'dun ni bsod nams kyi zhing khyad par can yin pas so// gzhi gsum de dag ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni zhib par cho gar rtogs par bya'o// drug pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen brten pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba la gsum/ gos mtha' gnyis su (40) ma lhung ba/ sman mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba/ gnas mal mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'o// dang po la bag yangs dang 'brel ba sra brkyang*/ dmigs bsal dang 'brel ba ko lpags/ gos gzhi dngos dang gsum las/ phyi ma cung zad bshad na lnga ste/ rung ba dang mi rung ba'i dbye ba/ rgyu rung ba las bzo tshul/ yo byad gsum gyi dbye ba byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs 'jig pa'i rgyu/ mtha' gnyis spang bar gdams pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyu mi rung ba ba lang dang ma he dang ri dwags kyi bal sogs kyis byas pa dang dbyibs dang*/

tshad mi rung ba rnams so// rgyu rung ba ni/ bal gos sha na nyi 'og dang*// ras gos dang ni zar ma dang*// ko tam pa dang du gu la// chos gos rgyu ni rnam pa bdun// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ rung ba'i gos rnyed pa de'ang*/ rgya skyegs leb rgan rtsi dang btsod// sman shing rtsi dang mthing shun mtshal// sin+dhu ra dang gur gum ste// 'di ni tshon chen brgyad du 'dod// ces pa de dag ma yin par/ sngon po btsag dang ngur smrig rtsi// 'di dag rung ba'i tshon gsum ste// zhes pa de dag gis kha bsgyur ba'o// 'on kyang bod 'dir sngon po khyim pa'i gos yin pas/ 'dul ba yul dus dang bstun zer ba ltar 'dul 'dzin snga ma rnams de'i tshab tu btsod kyis kha bsgyur ba'i gos bsten par mdzad pa yin par gsungs/ (41) de ltar kha bsgyur nas snam sbyar la nges par dras drub dgos/ gzhan rnams la dras drub dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ rnam sbyar nges par dras te bcang*// gzhan ni ma nges gang gi phyir// 'dod chung rang gi chos gos kyi// las kyis skyo ba 'phel phyir te// zhes gsungs so// snam sbyar la snam phran dang glegs bu'i grangs kyi dbye bas/ snam phran dgu pa nas nyer lnga'i bar dgu 'byung ba'i/ dang po gsum glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa/ 'bring gsum phyed dang bzhi pa/ rab gsum phyed dang lnga pa yin la/ de yang nyer lnga pa la dper mtshon na/ dbus su snam phran gcig la glegs bu phyed pa 'og tu 'byung ba'i bcad kha thur bstan/ g.yas su de'i 'gram nas snam phran bcu gnyis kyi glegs bu phyed pa snam phran gong 'og tu res mos kyi bstan pa'i phyogs su bcad kha 'gro ba'am/ yang na glegs bu'i 'gros de bzhin la bcad kha rnams thur bstan kho na byas kyang chog gsungs/ snam phran dang glegs bu thams cad bya spu non gyi tshul du sbyar zhing*/ g.yo phyogs kyi snam phran rnams kyang de bzhin du byas la/

mthar ji ltar rigs pa'i lcags ris bskor ro// de yang che tshad dpangs su khru gsum dang srid du khru lnga dang*/ chung tshad de bas khru phyed phyed phri ba 'bring de'i bar ro// bla gos ni snam phran bdun pa glegs bu phyed dang gsum (42) pa tshad snam sbyar dang mnyam mo// mthang gos snam phran lnga pa glegs bu phyed dang gnyis pa/ che tshad dpangs su khru do pa/ srid kha lnga pa yin kyang de ltar byas na g.yas g.yon du chags bsdu rgyu med pas ral kha dpung tshad yul dus dang 'tshams par lhan chog gsungs/ 'di rnams kyi tshal bu'i tshad sor bzhi'am gnyis dang phyed dang gsum yang rung ngo*// gding ba glegs bu phyed dang gnyis pa mtha' lcags ris bskor la zheng du khru do sor drug srid du khru gsum mo 'di rdul khrus gzhal dgos par gsungs/ gsum pa la gsum gyi dang po 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum ni/ sa gi lhas/ chos gos dras pa gsum dang ni// rdul gzan sham thabs gnyis gnyis dang*// g.yan pa dgab dang gding ba dang*// ras chen dang ni skra bzed dang*// gdong dang lag pa phyi ba ste// 'di dag bcu gsum dbye bar 'dod// ces pa ltar ro// de dag byin gyis brlabs pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ yul rten gnyis kas mchil lham phud cing yul rgan na phyag dang gzhon na phyag shad bya/ rang nyid kyis lus 'dud pa dang bcas te/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'tsho ba'i yo byad byin gyis rlob pa'i cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu zhes dang*/ gzhan rnams la mkho ba'i yo byad ces sogs kha bsgyur/ yul gyis chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin mdzad par zhu zhes brjod/ (43) gnyis ka 'grengs te snam sbyar sogs phyi nang ma log par bzhi bltab byas pa'i sne gcig yul gyi phrag pa g.yon par bkal gcig gnyis ka'i thal mo'i bar du bzung nas/ gnyis pa ni/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo zhes lan gsum brjod cing thabs legs bya/

bla gos sogs la ming brje ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// gsum pa ni/ phyag byas te dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po 'tsho ba'i yo byad byin gyis rlob pa'i cho ga la thugs gtad pa bka' drin che zhes dang*/ yul gyis chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin mdzad pa la rjes su yi rang ngo zhes brjod/ mgor snyan gsan zhu ba gnang ba sbyin pa dang mjug tu bka' drin brjod cing yi rang bya ba 'di rnams mkho yo sogs yo byad gzhan dang*/ sman byin rlabs dang*/ phyir bcos sogs la'ang skabs dang sbyar nas brjod shes par bya'o// 'di'i sbyor ba dang rjes kyi tshul 'og ma rnams kyi skabs su dran par bya'o// snam sbyar dngos med par rgyu byin rlabs byed dgos na/ der ras sogs khru gang ba yan chad kha bsgyur ba zhig sngar ltar bzung*/ dgongs gsol dang bcas te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo 'tshal na snam (44) phran dgu pa la sogs pa bgyis te/ glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa la sogs pa bgyi'o// bar chad ma byung na bkru'o bcang ngo dra bo sde bo bzung gdab bo drub bo kha bsgyur ro yang na 'di la lhan thabs glan no rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyis te chos gos 'di ni rung ba spyad par 'os pa'o zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ de bzhin du bla gos la snam phran bdun pa bgyis te glegs bu phyed dang gsum pa bgyi'o zhes dang*/ mthang gos la snam phran lnga pa glegs bu phyed dang gnyis pa zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas brjod/ 'tsho yo phran tshegs zhwa ska rags sman phor mchil lham lhung bzed kyi snod la sogs pa'o// de'i byin rlabs ni gzhan sngar bzhin la/ gos 'di zhwar byin gyis brlab bo zhes dang ska rags dang mchil lham gnyis la rigs 'gre'o// yo byad 'di sman phor du sogs de yang kun slong rang gi yin pa'i 'du shes kyis 'chang*/ gal te rkyen dag gis chos gos gsum dang bral na 'bral spang mi 'byung ba'i thabs su rang gi chos gos de'i byin rlabs phyung nas/

gos gzhan la byin rlabs byed pa yin la/ de yang chung ngu khru gang ba lta bu la byin rlabs mi chags par gsungs/ byin rlabs phyung tshul rang gi chos gos de mdun du yod par bsam la/ dgongs gsol dang bcas te/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i chos gos bgyis lags pa rung ba spyad par 'os (45) pa 'di chos gos snam sbyar du byin gyis brlabs pa las rkyen de lta bas na dngos po de slar dbyung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum brjod/ de nas gos gzhan zhig la byin rlabs byed dgos par de rgyu dang kha dog gis mi rung ba yin na dngos dang rgyu'i byin rlabs mi rung zhing*/ rkyen dbang gis byin rlabs dgos pas de'i sngags ni gzhan 'dra ba la ming 'di zhes bgyi bas gos 'di snam sbyar du byin gyis brlab bo zhes brjod/ gzhan gnyis la'ang des rigs 'gre'o// gnyis pa lhag pa'i yo byad ni/ mkhan slob sogs dge slong gzhan la yid gtad de 'chang du rung ba snam sbyar sogs dang*/ de dag gi rgyur bsngos pa'i rin chen dang ras yug sogs yin par gsungs/ byin rlabs byed pa'i sngags ni gzhan 'dra/ ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos lhag pa rung ba ma bgyis pa rung ba bgyi bar 'os pa 'di mkhan po'i lags par rung bar bgyi'o// mkhan po la yid gtad de bcang bar bgyi'o// rkyen ji lta ba bzhin du bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ yid gtad yul de slob dpon sogs yin na de dag gi ming gis rung ba bya zhing*/ gang la yid gtad pa de'i yin par bsams nas 'chang*/ lhag yo phran tsheg ni de dag gi rgyur bsngos shing khru gang gi tshad du ma longs pa rnams so// gsum pa mkho ba'i yo byad ni gdan gtur bu (46) dar ras sogs gos su byas pa dang ma byas pa rnams yin lags/ kha dog dang dbyibs la nges pa med pa rang gzhan thun mong ba'i bsam pas 'chang du rung ba yin no// de'i rgyur bsngo zhing khru tshad las chung ba rnams ni mkho yo phran tshegs so// de byin gyis rlabs pa ni/

ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gos 'di bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la mkho ba'i gos su byin gyis brlab bo zhes sam/ yo byad 'di sogs brjod pags 'gag sogs ko lpags las byas pa rnams kyang mkho ba'i yo byad du byin gyis brlabs na legs gsungs/ yo byad gsum po'i byin rlabs 'di rang gcig pus kyang 'grub par bshad do// dar ras khru gang du ma longs pa rnams yid kyis brtags te zhen med du 'chang ba las byin rlabs mi dgos te tshig ler/ khru yi tshad las chung ba la// byin rlabs yid brtan mi dgos so// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ 'chang ba po'i rten nyams pa bslab pa phul ba sogs dang*/ gzhan gyis 'phrog pa sogs yo byad de brlag pa dang*/ gzhan la byin pa dang*/ sngags tshig gis byin rlabs dbyung ba rnams gsum ka'i 'jig rgyu yin la/ yid gtad yul shi ba ni gnyis pa'i byin rlabs kyi 'jig rgyu yin no// lnga pa ni/ yo byad ngan ngon gyi chog mi shes par bzang mang la zhen pa bkag pa las 'das te bzang po la longs (47) spyod par 'dod pa bsod nyams kyi mtha' dang*/ rtsol med du rnyed cing gnang yang spyod mi nus pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis spang ba'i dbu ma la brten par gsungs so// gnyis pa sman la/ sman spyi'i ngo bo/ bye brag so so'i mtshan nyid/ byin gyis rlob pa'i thabs/ de la 'jug pa'i tshul/ phongs pa'i dus kyi dmigs bsal lo// dang po ni/ 'dod khams pa'i lus 'tsho ba'i rten du gyur pa'i dri ro reg bya gsum gyis bsdus pa'i kham zas so// gnyis pa la bzhi yod pa'i dang po dus rung gi sman ni/ bcas ldan rab byung gis rang gling gi skya rengs shar nas dgung tshigs tshun chad du longs spyod du rung ba zan dang snum khur la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa thun tshod du rung ba ni/ dge slong gis thun tshad kyi mtha' tshun chad du byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyod du rung ba tshags kyis btsags pa'i rtsab mo thams cad dang bu ram gyi khu ba sogs shin tu sla ba'o// de yang nyin mo'i thun tshon gling 'dir nyi ma shar nas ma nub kyi bar dang*/

mtshan mo'i thun tshod skar ma shar nas skya rengs ma shar gyi bar ro// sman de rang dus las 'das par 'chang na gsog 'jog tu 'gyur ro// gsum pa zhag bdun pa ni/ zhag bdun gyi mtha' tshun chod du byin gyis brlabs nas longs spyad du rung ba bu ram dang 'bru mar la sogs pa'o// (48) bzhi pa 'tsho bcang gi sman ni/ dge slong gi ji srid 'tsho'i bar du byin gyis brlabs nas 'chang du rung ba tsan+dan la sogs pa'o// gsum pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ sman de byin len byas te yul de rgan na phyag bya/ mdun du tsog pur 'dug gnyis ka'i lag pa g.yon par bzhag g.yas pas steng nas bkab la sman byin gyis rlabs pa'i cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu zhes dang*/ yul gyis chos bzhin sogs brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sman 'di dag bdag dang tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi don du nyin mo'i thun tshod kyi mtha' tshun chad du rung bar byin gyis brlab bo zhes lan gsum brjod/ thabs legs bya/ gzhan gnyis la'ang zhag bdun bar byin gyis brlab bo sogs rigs 'gre/ gsum pa ni drin brjod yi rang bya ba'o// bzhi pa la bsam sbyor gnyis kyi dang po ni/ chos sgrub pa'i rten 'tsho ba dang*/ nad gso ba'i ched dang*/ lus kyi srin bu la snying brtse ba la sogs pa'i bsam pas bza' bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ zas kyi phud kyis bla ma dang dkon mchog dang chos skyong la mchod/ de nas rang gis longs spyod pa'i mjug tu lhag gtor gyi tshul du chang bu re lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la ster dgos par gsungs/ lnga pa ni/ dmigs bsal mu ge'i dus (49) dang na ba'i tshe lag nya mtshams btsos zhag lon rjen btsos gsog 'jog brtsam ldang sa bon dang skye ba 'jig pa spang za byin len ma byas par za ba rnams la ltung ba med de/ gnang ba'i phyir ro zhes rin phreng dang lung rigs gter mdzod gnyis su gsungs pas de lta bu'i tshe dus dran brten pa nyid gal che'o// gsum pa la gnyis/

gnas mal gyi tshad/ de la longs spyod pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ gnas khang chung tshad spyod lam bzhi shong tsam dang*/ che tshad srid du khru bco brgyad zheng du khru phyed dang bcu gcig yin no// mal stan gyi tshad zheng du khru do sor drug srid du khru phyed dang lnga yin par gsungs/ 'di mkho ba'i yo byad du byin rlabs byed pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ mdor na rtsol sgrub chen pos bsgrubs pa 'dod pa bsod nyams dang yod kyang spyod mi nus pa ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' gnyis spangs nas chags zhen med par longs spyod par byed pa yin no// rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa la/ rtsod pa phyir bcos ni dgos pa chung bas dang*/ ltung ba phyir bcos la'ang nan tur gyi sgo nas phyir bcos tshul dang*/ spo mgu spyad pa'i sgo nas phyir bcos tshul ni lag tu len pa dka' bas ma bris so// 'dir bshags pas phyir bcos tshul bshad na/ yul/

(50) bsam pa/ cho ga dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ rab ltung bas gtan nas ma gos pa'i dge slong gi drung du'o// 'bring sde tshan de nyid kyis ma gos pa/ tha ma gang bshags par bya ba'i ltung ba des ma gos pa'i dge slong ngo*// de yang pham pa'i sbom po lci yang lhag ma'i sbom po lci ba rnams kyi bshags yul dge slong drug dang lnga la sogs pa dgos par gsungs/ sbom po lci yang ni sa gi lhas/ skrag par mi byed lci ba ste// gzhan gyis de la 'bad pa yis// bzlog kyang mi nyan rab lcir shes// gzhan la khrel yod yang ba ste// rang nyid ngo tshas shin tu yang*// bsam pa'i dbye bas 'gyur ba yin// zhes pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ snying nas bshags par 'dod cing sngar byas la 'gyod pa dang phyin chad mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' dang ldan pa'o// gsum pa ni/ spyir pham pa 'chab bcas byung na/ bshags pa byed tshul 'dul ba rang gzhung las ma gsungs kyang*/ rnam smin mi myong ba'i thabs su spyi bshags sogs la 'bad/ 'chab med la bslab pa nod de khyad par gyi spyod pa lnga spang*/ dman spyod lnga byed cing gnas dgos kyang de'i tshul gzhan du shes la/ lhag ma byung na/ spo mgu spyod pa'i yul deng sang mi rnyed kyang*/ lung las gang zag khyad par can gyi lhag ltung dge slong gcig gi mdun du bshags kyang (51) chog par gsungs/ mdo rtsar bsam pas ltung ba las ldang gi chad pa'i las kyis ni ma yin no zhes gsal bar gsungs pa des na rang gis sngar byas la 'gyod pa dang*/ phyin chad mi byed pa'i dam bca' yod na de gang zag khyad par can yin pas des dge slong gcig gi mdun du bshags kyang ltung ba las ldang bar gsungs/ spang ltung byung na spang 'bral sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ spang ltung phog pa'i gzhi'i rdzas de dang*/ de'i phyis rnyed kyi rdzas spang 'os su yod pa thams cad de yang yul dge slong zhig la bla gab tha mi dad pas mi chog pas gnas tha dad du spang dgos/

de'i tshul rang gi gnas khang der spang yul dge slong de zhag gcig bzhugs pa'am/ yang na rang gi lde mig de la phul ba gang rung bya/ byin 'phrog la rdzas de slar sbyin/ rang gi gos sogs gzhan la g.yar po zhus nas zhag gcig gnas gzhan du 'dug de'i tshe yang yig brgya sogs bshags pa'i rigs la 'bad pa phyag len yin gsungs/ de'i sang nyin gso sbyong gi skabs yin tshe dge 'dun gyi dbus su snying nas phyir bcos byed pa yin na bshags yul du 'os pa'i dge slong zhig la bshags yul bcol/ yul des tshe dang ldan pa khyod ci 'chags zhes dri/ rang gis spang ba'o zhes brjod/ 'o na spang 'bral sngon du song ngam/ (52) rang gis song lags zhes lan gdab/ spang yul bshags yul gcig yin na dri ba ma byas kyang chog cho ga dngos la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ thog mar yul rten gnyis kas rgyun chags gsum pa rgyas bsdus gang rung 'don yul de rgan na phyag dang gzhon na thang shad bya/ rang nyid 'grengs te 'dud pa dang bcas nas/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po ltung ba phyir bcos kyi cho ga la thugs gtad par zhu zhes dang*/ yul des chos bzhin sogs nas mdzad par zhu zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ yul gyi mdun du tsog pur 'dug cing*/ rang gi mkhan po yin na mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon la slob dpon zhes brjod/ min na btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la ltung ba spang ba ltung byed kyi sde las rnam par ma brtags pa'i gos zhag bcu las 'das par 'chang ba'i ltung ba byung ba'i nyes pa de btsun pa'i drung du mthol lo bshags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg cing gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum brjod/ yul gyis nyes pa la nyes par mthong ngam zhes dri zhing*/ rang gis mthong lags zhes dang*/ phyin chad legs par sdom mam/

rang gis sdom lags zhes lan gdab cing thabs legs bya/ lhag ma yin na lhag ma'i sde tshan las smyan (53) byed pa'i lhag ma byung ste lta bu dang*/ gzhan rnams la des rigs 'gre/ dge tshul yin na bdag dge tshul ming 'di zhes bya ba la ltung ba nyes byas kyi sde las phyi dro'i kha zas zos pa'i nyes pa byung ba'i kha na ma tho ba de sogs brjod/ gsum pa ni/ phyag byas te dge slong 'dul ba sogs nas gtad pa bka' drin che lags zhes dang*/ yul des chos bzhin 'dul ba bzhin bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang zhes dang*/ gnyis kas khrims kyi tshul khrims sogs brjod/ lar rang rgyud la nyes pa byung dang ma byung brtags nas byung na de dang zhag tu mi 'grogs par 'phral dang 'phral la bshags sdom byed pa yin mod/ de 'dra thugs nyams su bzhes pa dkon pas skabs skabs su spyi bshags nyid byed pa gnad du mthong zhing lar ltung ba gang byung ba rang ming gi smos nas phyir bcos dgos par gsungs pas 'byung nye ba rnams kyi rang ming gi smos nas spyi bshags byed pa'i tshul 'di bdag nyid kyi rnam rtog lags kyang mi rigs pa med dam snyam ste/ de yang gso sbyong gi tshe yin na snyan gsan zhu ba sogs phyag len bzhin byas te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang dge 'dun btsun pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge slong (54) ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mi shes pa dang ma gus pa dang bag med pa dang nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis so sor thar pa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba/ rin thang ma tshang ba'i dngos po brkus pa dang rdul khrod kyi sha za mthong bar smras pa la sogs pa pham pa'i sbom po lci yang rnams dang*/ bsam bzhin du khu ba 'byin pa dang chags sems kyis bud med la reg pa dang 'khrig tshig smras pa dang pho mo gnyen du bsdebs pa dang gzhi med dang bag tsam gyis dge slong la pham pas skur pa btab pa sogs lhag ma bcu gsum dang*/

de dag gi sbom po lci yang rnams dang*/ ma nges pa'i chos gnyis dang*/ gos rnam par ma brtags pa zhag bcu las 'das par bcang ba dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos gos gsum dang bral ba dang*/ stan byas nas lo drug ma lon par stan gzhan byas pa dang*/ gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che bdag gir byas pa dang*/ khe 'dod pa'i bsam pas mngon mtshan gyi spyod pa dang nyo tshong byas pa dang*/ sman gsum gsog 'jog byas pa la sogs pa spang ba'i ltung ba sum cu dang*/ shes bzhin du rdzun smras pa dang*/ dge slong gi skyon smras pa dang*/ de la phra ma byas pa dang*/ don ston byed du gyur pa'i chos dang yi ge bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig tu bton pa dang*/ sa bon dang skye ba 'jig par byas pa dang*/ zas spangs nas lhag (55) por ma byas par zos pa dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas dang gsog 'jog byas pa dang byin len ma byas pa'i zas zos pa dang*/ nyal po byed par shom pa'i khyim du bsdad pa dang*/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang nub gnyis las lhag par nyal ba dang*/ dgos pa med par me la reg pa dang*/ kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos brten pa dang*/ rin po che dang der smos pa la reg pa dang*/ bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba la sogs pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu dang*/ so sor bshags pa bzhi dang*/ sham thabs legs par ma bgos pa la sogs pa nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang der ma 'dus pa sha rjen zos pa dang*/ mna' 'dor ba la sogs pa sbom po dang nyes byas kyi rigs rnams dang*/ bshags yul yod bzhin du bshags pa ma bgyis pa dang*/ nyes pa bcab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs rang gis bgyis pa dang gzhan la bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa de dag thams cad/ phyogs bcu sogs nas dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyi drung du/

mthol lo mi 'chab bo bshags so// phyin chad kyang sdom par bgyid lags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg cing (56) gnas par 'gyur gyi ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum brjod/ gnas brtan gyis mthong sdom dri zhing thabs legs bya'o// dge tshul yin na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang dge 'dun btsun pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag shākya'i dge tshul ming 'di zhes bgyi ba mi shes pa dang ma gus pa dang bag med pa dang nyon mongs pa mang ba'i dbang gis so sor thar pa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba/ dud 'gro bsad pa dang*/ srog chags dang bcas pa'i chu la longs spyod pa dang*/ gzhi med dang bag tsam gyis pham pas skur pa btab pa dang*/ shes bzhin du rdzun smras pa dang*/ bslab gzhi khyad gsod byas pa dang*/ dgos pa med par gser dngul la sogs pa'i rin po che 'chang ba dang*/ glu gar dang rol mo byas pa dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas zos pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags nyams shing khyim pa'i rtags blang ba dang*/ gnas kyi slob dpon ma bsten pa dang*/ dus su gso sbyong ma byas pa sogs sgrub pa'i bslab pa la ma gnas pa dang*/ bshags yul yod bzhin du bshags pa ma bgyis pa la sogs pa ston pas ma gnang zhing spyad na nyes par 'gyur ba'i kha na ma tho ba gang rang gis (57) bgyis pa dang gzhan la bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba la sogs pa/ mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs de dag thams cad phyogs bcu na sogs nas dge 'dun btsun pa rnams kyi drung du mthol lo mi 'chab bo bshags so mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg cing gnas par 'gyur gyi ma mthol ma bshags na ni mi 'gyur ro// zhes lan gsum brjod/
